Dispositivo y sigue dando el mismo problema

Beware of unapproved charges.. Do not download this app. They will offer a 7-day free trial, but if you don't like the app and cancel they will still charge you, even within the trial period. In my case, I downloaded and deleted the app on the same day (including cancelling any subscriptions so that I wouldn't be charged in the future). I was charged the moment I deleted the app. I emailed their customer service via their website and have not received a reply. [MARCA] won't back you up even when you explain what happened. Don't fall for this shady practice. This has never happened to me with any other app trial. If I could give zero stars I would because the app also sucks.
